_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "birth_date" INTEGER NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "simple_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("simple_mode" IN (0, 1)), "blood_type" TEXT NULL, "allergies" TEXT NULL, "conditions" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medical_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "doctor_id" TEXT NULL, "cost_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NULL, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "doctors" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "specialty" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "clinic" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "fee_minor" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "insurance_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "insurer" TEXT NULL, "member_number" TEXT NULL, "expires_on" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "front_photo" TEXT NULL, "back_photo" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES medical_events (id), "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'photo', "caption" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prescriptions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "doctor_id" TEXT NULL, "prescribed_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "diagnosis" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "photos_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medicines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "strength" TEXT NULL, "form" TEXT NULL, "instructions" TEXT NULL, "doctor_id" TEXT NULL, "prescription_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES prescriptions (id), "position" INTEGER NULL, "stopped_with_prescription" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("stopped_with_prescription" IN (0, 1)), "start_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_on" INTEGER NULL, "photos_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dose_schedules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "medicine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES medicines (id), "times" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays" INTEGER NULL, "every_n_days" INTEGER NULL, "amount" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dose_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "medicine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES medicines (id), "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sick_episodes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "symptoms_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notes" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "temperature_readings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "episode_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sick_episodes (id), "taken_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "site" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "given_medicines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "episode_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sick_episodes (id), "medicine_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES medicines (id), "prescription_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES prescriptions (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" TEXT NULL, "given_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remind_next" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remind_next" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dose_logs_dose ON dose_logs (medicine_id, scheduled_at)
